observed: rev0305 file described rev0304/radiological-monitoring checks such as 509 files and S939-S952 while rev0305 report checked 514 files and S953-S966
why_it_matters: A passing validation report is less trustworthy when the rule catalog says it is testing a previous revision.
corrective_action: Regenerate validation-rules.json from the same source as validation-report on every revision.

observed: 361 cataloged CSVs while the package contained 391 CSVs; 30 rev0304/rev0305 CSVs were missing; 46 cataloged row counts were stale
why_it_matters: Query builders and auditors relying on the catalog see an older cube than the one actually shipped.
corrective_action: Regenerate table-schema-catalog.csv after every resource-producing step.

observed: 3127 cataloged columns versus 3391 actual CSV header columns before rev0306 additions
why_it_matters: Column-level discovery and schema validation are incomplete for the newest nuclear modules.
corrective_action: Regenerate table-column-catalog.csv with all CSV headers.

observed: 499 rows while index/file had 514 rows; ids 499-513 were absent
why_it_matters: A core lookup table omits the latest nuclear cyber, physical-security, radiological-monitoring and emergency-preparedness files.

observed: 439 blank title fields were present before rev0306 even though markdown H1/frontmatter titles were available
why_it_matters: Search, routing, and UI rendering degrade when canonical records lack titles.
corrective_action: Backfill title fields from frontmatter title or H1.

observed: Three all-gate crossproduct tables each contain 114494 rows; they dominate package size
why_it_matters: The cube is paying storage and cognitive cost for a universal all-gates-to-all-floors assumption that should often be an applicability relation or generated view.
corrective_action: Normalize gate library, gate applicability, and service-floor evidence status; materialize only exception/gap rows or generate crossproducts in SQLite views on demand.

observed: Two 2.57 MB files are byte-identical; local-assurance-gate-evaluation.csv and maturity-cap-execution.csv are also byte-identical
why_it_matters: Duplicates create ambiguity about canonical names and make downstream users wonder which table to trust.
corrective_action: Pick canonical names and replace aliases with a small alias map or symlink-like manifest entry.

observed: 437 rows have the same scorecard family, gate count, gap count, maturity ceiling, next action, public release, created revision and status; only service_floor_id varies
why_it_matters: This is okay as a generated view but poor as durable source data.
corrective_action: Represent the constant template once and join to service_floor_id in a view.

observed: SQLite mirror contains 20 imported CSV query surfaces out of hundreds of CSV resources
why_it_matters: The filename “datacube” can imply full cube parity even though it is a query-surface mirror.
corrective_action: Keep SQLite scope explicit in manifest and optionally add a full mirror build target later.

observed: rev0305 resource manifest used placeholder sha256 values such as not_recomputed_rev0305_fast_manifest
why_it_matters: A resource manifest without hashes cannot detect accidental edits or corruption.
corrective_action: Recompute hashes for all resources except the self-referential manifest row.

observed: schema.json still identified itself as rev0302 while the package was rev0305
why_it_matters: The schema may be stable, but the label creates avoidable uncertainty.
corrective_action: Update schema metadata or split schema_version from package_revision.

observed: Ids 499-508 repeat the id after the hyphen (e.g. 504-504_...), while 509-513 do not
why_it_matters: Inconsistent internal filename style increases routing friction even when ids remain valid.
corrective_action: Adopt one internal file naming convention and add a rename map if names are changed.
